title: U.S. TRANSCOM deploys randomised AI to secure military logistics
summary: U.S. Transportation Command (TRANSCOM) is implementing randomized AI systems to protect military logistics operations from adversarial tracking and contested disruptions, moving away from traditional static commercial freight scheduling that creates predictable patterns vulnerable to enemy exploitation.
problem_solved: Military logistics operations are vulnerable to adversarial tracking and disruption when using predictable, static scheduling systems commonly used in commercial freight.
why_valuable: It provides military planners with unpredictable routing capabilities that insulate global distribution networks against contested environments and enemy targeting.
